compiled_state.title: test-merge-to-main-portability: flaky CI failure on test_portability_merge2_succeeds and test_portability_feature_on_main
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Summary

test-merge-to-main-portability.sh intermittently fails in CI on tests:
- test_portability_merge2_succeeds (line 211)
- test_portability_feature_on_main (line 215)

Failure output:
```
FAIL: test_portability_merge2_succeeds
  expected to contain: DONE
  actual:              WARNING: pre-commit not found on PATH — git commit hooks may fail
```

## Repro

NOT reproducible locally — test passes 11/0 locally. Only observed in CI (GitHub Actions run 26358575139, PR #337).

## Context

- Test passes on main CI at 05:09 UTC 2026-05-24 (run 26352602435)
- Test fails on PR #337 CI at 10:21 UTC 2026-05-24 (run 26358575139)  
- Our PR changes: YAML corpus data files + ref-query.sh Python changes only
- Neither touched merge-to-main.sh, ensure-pre-commit.sh, or any portability test files
- Test 1 (test_portability_merge_succeeds, same setup) PASSES in the same CI run
- Test 2 fails with pre-commit warning suggesting ensure-pre-commit.sh state pollution between tests

## Root cause hypothesis

State pollution between test 1 and test 2 in the same CI run. ensure-pre-commit.sh or its venv activation may set PATH or env vars that affect test 2 differently. The test teardown (cleanup_env) does not reset PATH or shell state.

## Impact

Intermittent CI block on unrelated PRs.
